يستقربون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْرِبُونَ (yastaqribūna) /jas.taq.ri.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# يُسْتَقْرَبُونَ (yustaqrabūna) /jus.taq.ra.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
